{{Quote|These pictures are a week old, smuggled off Thaere by a Bothan sympathizer. They certainly seem to confirm the reports we've been getting these last few weeks of a military coup in the Thaereian system.|Osten Dal'Nay, to members of the Cularin Militia|<ref name="Storm's Depths" />}}
A military '''coup''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thaere Privo]] in the [[Thaereian system]] occurred during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
 
==The coup==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the grip of [[Thaereian military]]&mdash;the [[Army/Legends|armed forces]] of the [[Thaereian system]]&mdash;on the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]],<ref name="Storm's Depths" /> a nearby [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that the [[Thaereian]]s were [[Thaereian Navy charter|chartered]] to defend,<ref name="Over Thaere">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011004b_thaere&c=swlfc|text=Over Thaere|int=Over Thaere}}</ref> weakened amid a [[Thaereian War|conflict]] between the Thaereian military and the [[Cularin Militia]].<ref name="Storm's Depths" />  Circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]] and [[General/Legends|generals]] of the Thaereian military concluded that only through significant collective effort could the people of Thaere regain a dominant position in the Cularin system. To that end, the Thaereian military staged a coup on the Thaereian system [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thaere Privo]] to seize control of the [[Thaereian Government]] so as to ensure that the military would have priority over all other aspects of Thaereian society.<ref name="Storm's Depths" />
 
The coup was completed quickly and involved military [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeders]] and an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] passing through a [[City/Legends|built-up area]]. Rumors of the government overthrow spread off-world and a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Cularin Militia sympathizer smuggled footage of the coup to the Militia's leader, [[Osten Dal'Nay]]. One [[Standard week/Legends|week]] after the coup, Dal'Nay shared the recording with Cularin Militia members aboard the Militia [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Cularin 1]]'' over the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The Cularin Militia assessed that the change of government would have a positive short term impact for them since the Thaereian military would be focussed inward in the immediate aftermath.<ref name="Storm's Depths" /> Following the coup, the new military junta on Thaere covertly established ties with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Decision: Almas">{{LivingForce|Decision: Almas}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The coup on Thaere Privo first featured in the [[2004]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Inside-out: Storm's Depths]]'', which was written by [[Rob Edwards]] and formed part of the [[Inside-out trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] roleplaying game.<ref name="Storm's Depths" /> It was later referenced in the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Decision: Almas]]'', by [[Ronald A. Heintz]].<ref name="Decision: Almas" />
